- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:~302 and ~439 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: If an issue body changes between the two reads, `record_issue_integration_branches` appends conflicting values and `issue_integration_branch_for` silently selects the earlier branch.
  WHY: The reviewer reports that a mid-step edit could cause the sweeper to close an issue against a stale integration branch.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:around lines 4001-4004 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Matching the managed-issue marker anywhere in the body can classify an ordinary issue as managed and bypass the target-branch gate.
  WHY: A quoted marker in prose can trigger the body match; the reviewer notes the same false positive exists in `issue_pr_status.yml`, while the new gate magnifies its impact.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
